definitions.gloss: during class; in class; while class is in session
definitions.explanation: The period of time when a lesson or class is actively taking place. Used to describe what happens, what is prohibited, or what should be done while class is in session.

examples.japanese: {授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not use your smartphone during class.

examples.japanese: {授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}く→眠い：00872_nemui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I sometimes get sleepy during class.

examples.japanese: {授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧にして⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げて→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be quiet during class. If you have a question, please raise your hand.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧ (class, lesson) and ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (during, in the middle of). A very common compound that students encounter daily.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{居眠|いねむ}り→居眠り：01822_inemuri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to doze off during class
- {授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{私語|しご}: chatting during class
- {授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}する→質問する：05637_shitsumonsuru⟧: to ask a question during class

COMMON PATTERNS:
The ～⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ suffix attaches to many nouns to create 'during ~' expressions:
- ⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧: during a meeting
- {食事中|しょくじちゅう}: during a meal
- ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧: under construction
- ⟦{営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}→営業中：09539_eigyouchuu⟧: open for business
